'''Sir Mac'''<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]].<ref name="FF96" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Mac visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="FF96" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall on<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The Bith added to the interplanetary feel of the club that night.<ref name="FF96" />
